gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.eq: Stands on a slotted skirt, its outlet line leaving through the opening towards you; place up to 6 side connections
Lies on two saddles, along or across the constructor's facing; place up to 6 side connections

Trays and platforms on a skirt, the bottoms leaving through the skirt's port; feed and bottoms face you, reflux and pumparounds your right, draws, steam and the reboiler return your left. Build its exchangers, reboiler and ejector as units and run the pipes; or import a column calculator's design

A shell-and-tube exchanger (TEMA AES) on two saddles: the tube side in at the bottom of the channel towards you and out at its top, the shell side in on top and out underneath. Size its shell and tubes; condensers, coolers and heaters are exchangers
A kettle on two saddles: the heating medium through the tube bundle (channel towards you), liquid fed underneath, vapour leaving on top and the product over the weir at the back head
A bank of forced-draught bays, side by side in parallel and one behind the other in series, fans blowing up through each bundle; one inlet on top at the front, one outlet underneath at the back
An ejector standing on its own frame: suction towards you, motive steam on top, discharge downwards; sized by its suction
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sh: Shell inside diameter, 0.5 to 2.5 m in 0.25 m steps; the bundle fills it, about 75 D² m² of tube surface per metre of tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.tu: Tube length in whole metres, at least three bundle diameters and 2 m: up to 12 m for an exchanger, 10 m for a kettle
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sh: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bu: Tube bundle diameter, 0.5 to 2 m in 0.25 m steps; the kettle's shell is 1.6 times it, leaving the vapour space over the boiling pool
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ke: Height of the kettle's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ba: Width across the tubes × length from header to header, 1.5 to 3 m by 3 to 6 m: only bays whose fans can cover 40 % of the bundle (API 661)
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: Bays side by side sharing the flow, 1 to 6: an inlet manifold over their first headers and an outlet manifold behind their last join them
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.se: Bays one behind the other, 1 to 4: the flow passes each in turn, crossover spools join each back header to the next front header
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bu: Height of the tube bundle's bottom above the ground, 5 to 16 m, leaving the fans and their motors room underneath
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.su: Suction nozzle diameter, 0.1 to 1 m in 0.1 m steps; the ejector is 8.3 times as long
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.di: Height of the discharge flange above the ground, 1 to 16 m
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.su: Outside surface of the bundle's tubes: about 1,260 D² tubes of 3/4 inch on a 1 inch pitch, 75 D² m² per metre of tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ke: Shell %s m, tube surface about %s m²
The kettle's shell over its bundle (1.6 times), and the outside surface of the bundle's tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ba: Bundle face %s m², %s fans of %s m
The bank's bundle face between its headers, which the air crosses, and the fans under it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ej: From the steam chest to the diffuser's exit: 8.3 suction diameters
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ax: Along (lengthwise) or across (crosswise) the constructor's facing
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.im: Take the trays, feed, side draws, pumparounds, steam and diameter of the nearest column calculator within %s blocks
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.tr: Number of trays, 1 to 64, 0.6 m apart; the column's height follows from them
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fe: Where the feed enters, counted from the top: tray 1 sits under the condenser, the last stage (trays + 1) is the sump
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.di: Inside diameter of the shell in 0.5 m steps: 0.5 to 10 m for a drum, up to 15 m for a column
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ta: Straight shell between the two head seams (tangent to tangent), 1 to 64 m. Each 2:1 head adds a quarter of the diameter
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sk: Height from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m, at least enough to enclose the head. The default leaves about 1 m under the head for the bottom outlet line, which leaves through the skirt's opening; slots show the inside
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sa: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 1 to 16 m. The two saddles sit a fifth of the length in from each head seam
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fo: Blocks from the constructor to the vessel's near side, 1 to 16; 1 puts it right next to the constructor
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ri: Moves the vessel sideways, in blocks: to your right as you look from the constructor towards it, to your left when negative
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.up: Raises the vessel's ground above the constructor's level, in blocks; lowers it when negative
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ex: Height of the vessel's top above its ground, and its length along the axis over both heads
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.vo: Inside volume of the shell and heads, which is the reservoir's capacity, and the outside area of the shell and heads
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ce: Blocks the vessel takes: shell cells carry the drawn wall, interior cells are the space inside it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.st: Build needs every cell of the ghost free; blocks in the way are outlined red in the world
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.co: Inlets and outlets on the drum's shell, up to 6: the side each faces, its height (a lying drum's place along it) and its offset across the shell
Which side connection the rows below edit
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fa: The side the nozzle faces as you look from the constructor: front (towards you), left, back, right, and on a lying drum top and bottom. Click to turn it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.he: Height of the nozzle's centre line above the vessel's ground, m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.al: Distance of the nozzle's centre line from the end of the front head (the liquid outlet's end), m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.of: Moves the nozzle off the centre line across the shell, in whole blocks: a hillside nozzle, its pipe parallel to a centred one. The further out, the smaller the largest pipe
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ad: Places a new side connection where it meets nothing: a standing drum's as high as it goes, a lying drum's nearest its front head. Up to %s
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.re: Takes the selected side connection away
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.co: Neck up to %s m at the shell

The widest neck the shell carries where the nozzle stands: its edge stays 0.05 m inside the head seams and within the shell's curve. Any pipe connects: the nozzle's flange takes the pipe's size, a larger pipe's neck widening in a reducer just outside the vessel
A side connection is an inlet, or an outlet drawing all phases together; the top outlet draws vapour first, the bottom outlet liquid
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: Colours of the metal parts: the body and the structure, from the palette or your own
Edit the body's colour: shell, heads, cladding and a unit's casings
Edit the structure's colour: skirt, saddles and steelwork
RAL colours seen on process plants; click one to paint the edited part
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.cu: Any colour as #RRGGBB: it paints the edited part once six digits are typed
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: White aluminium (RAL 9006) on blue grey steel (RAL 7031)
Pipes, flanges and rails keep theirs
Pipes, flanges, nozzles, gratings, handrails, motors and actuators keep their own colours
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.cl: Build waits until no side connection meets another nozzle, a saddle or the ground, each at its largest pipe and flange
Connection %s has no room above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.exchanger: Shell-and-tube exchanger (TEMA AES) on two saddles
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.ejector: Steam ejector on its own frame
gui.createcheme.vessel.bundle: Bundle %s m in a %s m shell
gui.createcheme.vessel.fans: %s fans of %s m per bay, %s %% of its bundle
gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.exch: Shell bottom %s m above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.kett: Kettle bottom %s m above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.ejec: Discharge flange %s m above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.skirt: Vertical drum on a skirt, 2:1 heads
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.saddles: Horizontal drum on two saddles, 2:1 heads
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.column: Distillation column of %s trays on a skirt, 2:1 heads
gui.createcheme.vessel.nozzle: %s: %s port, faces %s, neck up to %s m
gui.createcheme.vessel.saddles: Saddles %s m high, %s m inside the tangent lines
gui.createcheme.vessel.unsupported: No support: rests on its lower head
message.createcheme.equipment.built: Built a %s m × %s m drum: %s cells from %s
message.createcheme.equipment.built_colu: Built a %s m column of %s trays: %s cells from %s
message.createcheme.equipment.no_calcula: No column calculator within %s blocks of the constructor
message.createcheme.equipment.imported: Imported the column design: %s trays, feed on tray %s, %s m diameter

gui.createcheme.column.title: COLUMN / %s
gui.createcheme.column.draft_changed: Draft changed; solve to calculate results
gui.createcheme.column.conflict: Server inputs changed; choose a draft
gui.createcheme.column.solve.hint: Validate and solve this draft. Results arrive on the engine update schedule.
gui.createcheme.column.use_server.hint: Discard the local draft and use the latest server configuration.
gui.createcheme.column.keep_draft.hint: Keep your local inputs and solve against the latest server revision.
Switch all temperature fields and results between Celsius and Kelvin. The physical values do not change.
Load operating settings and connections from JSON. Keep the current mixture unchanged. Files refresh only when this browser is opened or refreshed.
gui.createcheme.column.mixture_templates: Load composition from JSON. Keep the current column settings unchanged. Files refresh only when this browser is opened or refreshed.
gui.createcheme.column.save_column.hint: Save operating settings and connections to a client-side JSON file. The composition is not included.
gui.createcheme.column.save_mixture.hint: Save the selected components, relative amounts and composition basis to a client-side JSON file. Column settings are not included.
gui.createcheme.column.back.hint: Close the preset browser without changing the draft.
gui.createcheme.column.refresh.hint: Read bundled and custom JSON presets again. No background refresh is performed.
gui.createcheme.column.save_json.hint: Create a new custom preset file. Existing files are preserved.
gui.createcheme.column.preset_filename_h: Use letters, numbers, spaces, _ or -. Existing files receive a numbered suffix.
gui.createcheme.column.saved: Saved %s. Open presets to refresh the list.
gui.createcheme.column.save_failed: Cannot save. Check the filename, inputs and directory permissions.
gui.createcheme.column.preset_incompatib: This preset is invalid or its material package is unavailable on the server.
gui.createcheme.column.tray_count.hint: Total number of trays, including tray 1 (condenser) and the last tray (reboiler). Minimum 2: a pot. Maximum 66.
gui.createcheme.column.diameter.hint: Column diameter used by the tray hydraulics calculation.
gui.createcheme.column.reflux.hint: Organic liquid returned from tray 1 divided by liquid distillate.
gui.createcheme.column.top_pressure.hint: Absolute top pressure in bar. Condenser and reboiler have no separate pressure drop.
gui.createcheme.column.feed_flow.hint: Total hydrocarbon feed flow. Component flow rates use the current normalized composition.
Feed temperature in the selected temperature unit.
gui.createcheme.column.feed_tray.hint: Feed location using total tray numbering. Feed enters below tray 1; a pot is fed at its last tray.
gui.createcheme.column.duty.hint: Heat added to the last tray, the reboiler, in megawatts.
gui.createcheme.column.draw_flow.hint: Liquid withdrawn at this tray. The draw must leave positive liquid downflow.
gui.createcheme.column.draw_tray.hint: Interior tray where liquid is withdrawn.
gui.createcheme.column.return_tray.hint: Interior tray where the pumparound returns; above its draw tray.
gui.createcheme.column.cooling.hint: Positive heat removal assigned to this pumparound.
gui.createcheme.column.uniform_heat.hint: Distribute cooling across the PA span. Click to apply it at the return tray instead.
gui.createcheme.column.return_heat.hint: Apply cooling at the PA return tray. Click to distribute it across the span.
gui.createcheme.column.steam_flow.hint: Steam molar flow entering at this connection.
gui.createcheme.column.injection_tray.hi: Steam injection location. Injection at the last tray is bottom steam.
gui.createcheme.column.steam_temperature: Steam temperature. Steam must be superheated at the injection pressure.
gui.createcheme.column.add_draw.hint: Add a liquid draw at the selected interior tray. Up to four draws.
gui.createcheme.column.add_pa.hint: Add a pumparound near the selected interior tray. Up to four PAs.
gui.createcheme.column.add_steam.hint: Add steam injection at the selected tray. Select the last tray for bottom steam. Up to two injections.
gui.createcheme.column.remove_draw.hint: Remove this draw from the local column draft.
gui.createcheme.column.remove_pa.hint: Remove this pumparound from the local column draft.
gui.createcheme.column.remove_steam.hint: Remove this steam injection from the local column draft.
gui.createcheme.column.clear_mixture.hin: Start an empty custom mixture. Add only the components you need.
gui.createcheme.column.composition_basis: Switch relative amounts, normalized percentages and component flow rates between molar and mass basis. The physical mixture is preserved.
gui.createcheme.column.flow_basis.hint: Switch all composition and flow-rate values between molar and mass basis.
gui.createcheme.column.relative_amount.h: A non-negative relative amount. Values do not need to sum to 100%; a positive total is normalized.
Remove this component from the mixture.
gui.createcheme.column.empty_mixture: Search for a component above, or load a mixture.
gui.createcheme.column.drawing_hint: Click a tray or connection to inspect or edit it.
gui.createcheme.column.feed_icon.hint: Open the feed composition table. Flow, temperature and location are edited below this connection.
gui.createcheme.column.draw_icon.hint: Draw %s at tray %s. Click to edit flow/location or remove it.
gui.createcheme.column.pa_icon.hint: Pumparound %s. Click to edit cooling duty, draw/return trays or remove it.
gui.createcheme.column.steam_icon.hint: Steam injection %s at tray %s. Click to edit flow, temperature, location or remove it.
gui.createcheme.column.uncorrected_press: The hydraulic pressure correction was not accepted; inspect the solver report.
gui.createcheme.column.dew_warning: A tray is below its water dew point without an admitted aqueous phase; inspect the solver report.
gui.createcheme.column.liquid_depletion: A side draw exhausts tray liquid. Reduce withdrawal or increase liquid traffic.
gui.createcheme.column.pressure_failure: The pressure profile is outside the supported range. Check pressure and column diameter.
gui.createcheme.column.solver_failed_hin: No accepted solution. Check the inputs; copy the solver report for detailed evidence.
gui.createcheme.column.pressure_drop.hin: Pressure drop per tray interval in kPa. At diameter 0 it sets the uniform profile; at a positive diameter it is the first guess the tray hydraulics correct.
gui.createcheme.column.profile_metric.hi: Cycle temperature, pressure, tray pressure drop and phase traffic.
gui.createcheme.column.traffic_legend: Teal organic phase / amber vapor / blue steam / violet aqueous phase
gui.createcheme.column.profile_click.hin: Click a profile point to inspect its tray.
gui.createcheme.column.solve_products: Solve to view product compositions and component flows.
gui.createcheme.column.terminal_no_dp: Tray 1 and the last tray have no dP. A pot has zero column dP.
gui.createcheme.column.signed_heat: Signed heat: positive in, negative out
gui.createcheme.column.copy_report.hint: Copy raw solver diagnostics and numerical evidence to the clipboard.
gui.createcheme.column.request_rejected: The server rejected this request. Refresh the column or check its inputs.
gui.createcheme.column.invalid_input: Check tray count, feed location and numeric inputs.
gui.createcheme.column.invalid_mixture: Add supported components with finite non-negative amounts and a positive total.
gui.createcheme.column.invalid_draw: Check draw locations and rates. Total draw must be below total feed.
gui.createcheme.column.invalid_steam: Check steam location, superheat and flow. Total steam must not exceed feed.
gui.createcheme.column.invalid_pa: Check PA draw/return trays and positive cooling duty.
gui.createcheme.column.draw_balance: Draw at tray %s: requested %s kmol/h; internal liquid %s kmol/h.
gui.createcheme.column.overview.hint: Edit the column drawing and inspect solver and tray information.
gui.createcheme.column.composition.hint: Edit the feed mixture and inspect component flow rates.
gui.createcheme.column.results.hint: Inspect accepted profiles, product streams and duties.
gui.createcheme.column.diagnostics.hint: Inspect acceptance checks and copy detailed solver evidence.
gui.createcheme.column.profiles.hint: View temperature, pressure, pressure drop and traffic profiles.
gui.createcheme.column.streams.hint: View product compositions and component flow rates.
gui.createcheme.column.heat.hint: View accepted tray duties and the column heat balance.
gui.createcheme.column.open_folder.hint: Open this client preset folder to edit or add JSON files. Click Refresh after editing.
gui.createcheme.column.benchmark_hint: Fixed Holland benchmark. Select its column and mixture templates independently to reconstruct the reference case; other physical edits are not supported by this benchmark.
gui.createcheme.column.connections.hint: Choose a connection to add at the selected tray.
gui.createcheme.fluid.search: Search by component name or ID
gui.createcheme.fluid.waiting: Waiting for the next simulation update.
gui.createcheme.fluid.invalid_compositio: Enter non-negative amounts with a positive total.
gui.createcheme.fluid.invalid_number: Enter a valid temperature before changing units.
gui.createcheme.fluid.invalid_input: Check numeric inputs and composition; amounts must be non-negative with a positive total.
gui.createcheme.fluid.invalid_ratio: Max pressure ratio (out/in) must lie between %s and %s.
gui.createcheme.fluid.invalid_solid: Each solid row needs a material ID, size and relative mass share.
gui.createcheme.fluid.mixture_loaded: Mixture loaded. Apply changes to update the generator.
gui.createcheme.fluid.outlets.hint: Top outlets draw gas first, then the lighter and the heavier liquid phase. Bottom outlets draw the heaviest liquid phase first, then the lighter one, then gas. Side outlets draw all phases together. Inflow through any face is not distinguished.
gui.createcheme.fluid.datasheet.hint: The drum's sizes and its nozzles: what each nozzle is for, the port its position gives it, where it faces and the largest pipe it takes.
gui.createcheme.fluid.mixture_library: Select a mixture to fill the composition.
gui.createcheme.fluid.empty_mixture: Add a component using the search dropdown, or load a mixture.
gui.createcheme.fluid.overview.hint: Inspect the most recently delivered process state.
gui.createcheme.fluid.composition.hint: Define the generator mixture with relative molar or mass amounts.
gui.createcheme.fluid.solids.hint: Edit suspended solids separately from the fluid composition.
gui.createcheme.fluid.apply.hint: Queue these controls for the next simulation update.
gui.createcheme.fluid.recover.hint: Recover the solids currently captured by this filter.
gui.createcheme.fluid.refresh.hint: Read the mixture files again. Files are refreshed only on request.
gui.createcheme.fluid.load_mixture.hint: Load a server preset or compatible client JSON mixture.
gui.createcheme.fluid.new_mixture.hint: Clear the fluid composition and add your own components.
gui.createcheme.fluid.relative_hint: Amounts are relative; the total need not be 100%.
Search names or IDs, including partial names and small typos. Use Up/Down and Enter, or click a match. Escape dismisses the list.
gui.createcheme.fluid.connections.hint: Readings for every connected pipe. Flow direction is selected automatically.
gui.createcheme.fluid.throughput.hint: Transport during the last completed interval. Junctions count outgoing material once. Reversals include transport in both directions.
gui.createcheme.fluid.velocity.hint: Accepted volume transported during the last 5 seconds of online simulation time, divided by 5 seconds and this pipe’s bore area. Includes both flow directions and steady-flow replay. Startup, reload and topology changes warm up from zero history; partial intervals use their mean rate. Junctions show the range across connections.
gui.createcheme.fluid.gradient.hint: Absolute pressure difference between connected endpoints divided by their pipe length, including elevation effects. This is a path average; junctions show a range.
gui.createcheme.fluid.phase_ratio.hint: Volume fractions of the transported organic phase, aqueous phase, vapor and solids during the last completed interval.
gui.createcheme.fluid.phase_ratio.tank_h: Volume fractions of the organic phase, aqueous phase, vapor and solids this tank holds in the last published state.
gui.createcheme.fluid.velocity_limited: Flow is limited by the allowed fluid velocity.
